items.stem: What is the news report mainly about?

choices.text: Zuckerberg wrote a letter to his new-born baby girl.
choices.zh: Zuckerberg给他刚出生的女儿写了一封信。

choices.text: Zuckerberg wants his baby girl to grow up in a better world.
choices.zh: Zuckerberg希望他的女儿在一个更美好的世界中长大。

choices.text: Zuckerberg became one of the most searched names on Google.
choices.zh: Zuckerberg成为Google上搜索次数最多的名字之一。

choices.text: Zuckerberg decided to donate most of his Facebook shares.
choices.zh: Zuckerberg决定捐出他持有的大部分Facebook股份。

items.stem: How much are the stock shares to be donated by Zuckerberg worth now?

choices.text: About $45 million.
About $50 million.
About $45 billion.
About $99 billion.

items.stem: What can we learn about the draft agreement?

choices.text: It was approved on Sunday.
It runs to 42 pages.
It targets rich countries tackling climate change.
choices.zh: 它针对富裕国家应对气候变化。

choices.text: It has a clear vision to go renewable energy.
choices.zh: 它对可再生能源有清晰的愿景。

items.stem: Where have the twelve mini-icebergs been placed?

choices.text: In Denmark.
In Greenland.
In Durban.
In the Place de la Pantheon.

items.stem: Who is Mauricio Macri?

choices.text: The ruling party candidate.
The chosen successor of Argentina's president.
choices.zh: 阿根廷总统钦定的接班人。

choices.text: The governor of Buenos Aires province.
choices.zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯省省长。

choices.text: The mayor of Buenos Aires.
choices.zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯市市长。

items.stem: What does Mr. Macri want to do?

choices.text: Tighten trade restrictions.
Lift some financial controls.
Carry out social welfare programs.
Seek the help of economic reform.

items.stem: What was said about the Argentine election law?

choices.text: A candidate with over 45 percent of the vote could win the presidency.
choices.zh: 获得超过45%选票的候选人可以赢得总统职位。

choices.text: A candidate who has 10 more points over the second wins the presidency.
choices.zh: 比第二名多10个百分点的候选人赢得总统职位。

choices.text: Any candidate who wins the most of the vote could be the winner.
choices.zh: 任何赢得最多选票的候选人都可能是获胜者。

choices.text: Any candidate who wins at least 40 percent of the vote gets elected.
choices.zh: 任何赢得至少40%选票的候选人都会当选。

items.stem: What does the man say about Chinese?

choices.text: It is more difficult to learn than English.
It is used by more people than English.
choices.zh: 使用它的人比使用英语的人多。

choices.text: It will be as commonly used as English.
choices.zh: 它将和英语一样被普遍使用。

choices.text: It will eventually become a world language.
choices.zh: 它最终将成为一种世界语言。

items.stem: What made English a widely-used language?

choices.text: Its loan words from many languages.
choices.zh: 它从许多语言中借用的词汇。

choices.text: Its popularity with the common people.
choices.zh: 它在普通民众中的流行程度。

choices.text: The influence of the British Empire.
The effect of the Industrial Revolution.

items.stem: What is said to be special about English vocabulary?

choices.text: It includes a lot of words from other languages.
choices.zh: 它包含大量来自其他语言的词汇。

choices.text: It has a growing number of newly coined words.
choices.zh: 它有越来越多的新造词。

choices.text: It can be easily picked up by overseas travellers.
choices.zh: 它可以被海外旅行者轻松掌握。

choices.text: It is the largest among all languages in the world.
choices.zh: 它是世界上所有语言中词汇量最大的。

items.stem: What does the man say is the second advantage of English?

choices.text: It has many international words.
choices.zh: 它有许多国际通用词汇。

choices.text: It can be pronounced easily.
Its grammar is very simple.
It has no different dialects.

items.stem: What is the woman's purpose in making the phone call?

choices.text: To return some goods.
To apply for a job.
To place an order.
To make a complaint.

items.stem: What do we learn about the man from the conversation?

choices.text: He has become somewhat impatient with the woman.
choices.zh: 他对女士变得有些不耐烦了。

choices.text: He is not familiar with the exact details of the goods.
choices.zh: 他不熟悉商品的具体细节。

choices.text: He has not worked in the sales department for long.
choices.zh: 他在销售部工作的时间不长。

choices.text: He works on a part-time basis for the company.

items.stem: What does the man say about delivery?

choices.text: It is not his responsibility.
It will be free for large orders.
It costs £15 more for express delivery.
choices.zh: 快递配送需要额外支付15英镑。

choices.text: It depends on a number of factors.

items.stem: What does the woman say she will possibly do tomorrow?

choices.text: Report the information to her superior.
Pay a visit to the saleswoman in charge.
Ring back when she comes to a decision.
Make inquiries with some other companies.

items.stem: What does the speaker say about kites?

choices.text: No one knows exactly where they were first made.
choices.zh: 没有人确切知道风筝最初是在哪里制作的。

choices.text: No one knows for sure when they came into being.
choices.zh: 没有人确定风筝是何时出现的。

choices.text: No one knows for what purpose they were invented.
choices.zh: 没有人知道风筝是出于什么目的被发明的。

choices.text: No one knows what they will look like in the future.
choices.zh: 没有人知道风筝将来会是什么样子。

items.stem: What did ancient Chinese use kites to do?

choices.text: Carry ropes across rivers.
Measure the speed of wind.
Pass on secret messages.
Give warnings of danger.

items.stem: Why did Benjamin Franklin fly a kite in the storm?

choices.text: To protect houses against lightning.
To test the effects of the lightning rod.
To find out the strength of silk for kites.
choices.zh: 找出丝绸制作风筝的强度。

choices.text: To prove that lightning is electricity.

items.stem: What does the speaker say about herself?

choices.text: She enjoys teaching languages.
She can speak several languages.
She was trained to be an interpreter.
She was born with a talent for languages.

items.stem: What does the speaker say about many people who have lived overseas for a while?

choices.text: They acquire an immunity to culture shock.
choices.zh: 他们对文化冲击产生了免疫力。

choices.text: They would like to live abroad permanently.
choices.zh: 他们想永久居住在国外。

choices.text: They want to learn as many foreign languages as possible.
choices.zh: 他们想学习尽可能多的外语。

choices.text: They have an intense interest in cross-cultural interactions.
choices.zh: 他们对跨文化交流有浓厚兴趣。

items.stem: How did the speaker's experience of living in Vienna benefit her?

choices.text: She became an expert in horse racing.
She got a chance to visit several European countries.
choices.zh: 她有机会访问了几个欧洲国家。

choices.text: She was able to translate for a German sports judge.
choices.zh: 她能够为一位德国体育裁判做翻译。

choices.text: She learned to appreciate classical music.
choices.zh: 她学会了欣赏古典音乐。

items.stem: What was the speaker asked to do in the Japanese studio?

choices.text: Taste the beef and give her comment.
Take part in a cooking competition.
Teach vocabulary for food in English.
Give cooking lessons on Western food.

items.stem: What do we learn about Ben Carsen?

choices.text: He had only a third-grade education.
choices.zh: 他只有三年级的教育水平。

choices.text: He once threatened to kill his teacher.
choices.zh: 他曾经威胁要杀死他的老师。

choices.text: He grew up in a poor single-parent family.
choices.zh: 他在一个贫困的单亲家庭中长大。

choices.text: He often helped his mother do housework.
choices.zh: 他经常帮助母亲做家务。

items.stem: What did Ben Carsen's classmates and teachers think of him when he was first at school?

choices.text: Careless.
Stupid.
Brave.
Active.

items.stem: What did Ben Carsen's mother tell him to do when he was a school boy?

choices.text: Write two book reports a week.
Keep a diary.
Help with housework.
Watch educational TV programs only.
